items.title: Create M1 protocol lock and status table
items.context: Record the protocol document digest and create an operator-readable M1 status table without editing the protocol document itself.

happy.desc: protocol.lock.json matches the SHA-256 digest of docs/requirements/decisions/multi-model-ablation-replication.md and m1-status.md marks M1 as provider-free.

edge.desc: README.md is not modified or included in the story scope even if the root worktree has unrelated local edits.

adversarial.desc: the status table must not claim Phase 1 has started or that model snapshots are locked when they are only launch blockers.

verificationEvidence.note: protocol.lock.json digest still matches the protocol document and m1-status.md marks M1 provider-free after the checker fix Evidence: M1 freeze checker passed: 219 assertions; 8 negative controls rejected.
the story worktree still did not modify README.md; business changes remain limited to M1 experiment artifacts Evidence: M1 freeze checker passed: 219 assertions; 8 negative controls rejected.
m1-status.md and launch artifacts still do not claim Phase 1 started or snapshots are locked Evidence: M1 freeze checker passed: 219 assertions; 8 negative controls rejected.

items.title: Create deterministic seed and cell matrix manifests
items.context: Represent planned Phase 1 cells for required ③/⑥ and required ②, with ④ labeled optional budget-permitting, without running providers or writing outcome records.

happy.desc: manifests include deterministic seed derivation and required Phase 1 cells ③, ⑥, and ②, plus optional budget-permitting ④ as a separately labeled extension.

edge.desc: A2prime cells remain blocked until same-family A4 budget calibration exists, and ④ may be absent without making M1 incomplete.

adversarial.desc: ② vs ④ must not be marked as a legal confirmatory comparison because both executor and reviewer vary; missing required ② must fail the checker.

verificationEvidence.note: seed and cell matrix manifests include deterministic dimensions and required Phase 1 cells ③, ⑥, and ② plus optional ④ Evidence: M1 freeze checker passed: 219 assertions; 8 negative controls rejected.

A2prime ⑥ remains blocked behind ③-derived A4 calibration and budget lock sequencing; the checker now also accepts a required-only matrix without optional ④ Evidence: M1 freeze checker passed: 219 assertions; 8 negative controls rejected.
the checker rejects missing required ② and illegal ②-vs-④ confirmatory use while allowing optional ④ absence Evidence: M1 freeze checker passed: 219 assertions; 8 negative controls rejected.

items.title: Create Phase 1 launch gate and budget rule artifact
items.context: Make launchAllowed=false until human approval, dated snapshots, task inventory, and budget locks are present.

happy.desc: launch gate lists blockers and confirms M1 is a pre-campaign lock, not a campaign run.

adversarial.desc: DONE cannot be used to imply Phase 1 campaign readiness or product gate behavior.

verificationEvidence.note: phase1-launch-gate.m1.json lists blockers and identifies M1 as pre-campaign lock only Evidence: M1 freeze checker passed: 111 assertions; 7 negative controls rejected.
providerCallEnabled and formalPhase1UseAllowed remain false Evidence: M1 freeze checker passed: 111 assertions; 7 negative controls rejected.
DONE of this story cannot authorize Phase 1 campaign execution or product gate behavior Evidence: M1 freeze checker passed: 111 assertions; 7 negative controls rejected.

items.title: Implement local M1 freeze checker
items.context: Add a deterministic checker that validates M1 artifacts and rejects common invalid states before costly Phase 1 execution.

happy.desc: node experiments/multi-model-ablation/m1-freeze-check.mjs passes and prints assertion counts.

edge.desc: the checker permits missing optional ④ while still requiring Phase 1 ③, ⑥, and ② and enforcing A2prime budget sequencing.

adversarial.desc: negative controls reject drifted protocol digests, launchAllowed=true, provider calls, outcome fields, missing required ②, A2prime-before-budget, and illegal ② vs ④ confirmatory comparison.

verificationEvidence.note: the local M1 freeze checker passes and prints assertion and negative-control counts Evidence: M1 freeze checker passed: 111 assertions; 7 negative controls rejected.
the checker allows optional ④ absence while requiring ③, ⑥, and ② and enforcing A2prime sequencing Evidence: M1 freeze checker passed: 111 assertions; 7 negative controls rejected.

negative controls reject drift, premature launch/provider flags, outcome fields, missing ②, A2prime-before-budget, and illegal ②-vs-④ confirmatory comparison Evidence: M1 freeze checker passed: 111 assertions; 7 negative controls rejected.
